report.dataModel: No Matter/RainMaker model. MQTT: publish current_heating_setpoint to zigbee2mqtt/<TRV> (qos1, retain 0); on connect subscribe every TRV/air-sensor topic and publish an empty message to each; time 254 to zigbee2mqtt/bridge/request/permit_join; retained status topic zerocode/mac/status with last-will. Every accepted room message is logged with room name and a truncated payload. HTTP /settings (GET/POST), /api/state, /api/set.

findings.description: The new offline policy cannot be turned on by anything: app_mqtt_set_offline_policy() has no caller, so s_offline_retry_forever stays true and the give-up branch that stops the client and logs 'broker unreachable for N s' is dead. The writer's claim that the transport now gives up after 300 s is not reachable from the shipped firmware; the 'retrying every 30 s' wording in that message also does not match OFFLINE_RETRY_S and is never used by mqtt itself, which uses its own back-off.
findings.evidence: app_mqtt.cpp:269-273 app_mqtt_set_offline_policy() defined; static bool s_offline_retry_forever = true at :63; the only consumer is the DISCONNECTED branch :197-208; a search of firmware/components finds no call to app_mqtt_set_offline_policy outside app_mqtt.cpp and its header declaration (app_mqtt.h:107).
findings.failureScenario: An operator reads the writer's summary or the message text and expects the panel to stop dialling an unreachable broker after 300 s and print one clear line; in the shipped image the branch can never fire, the log keeps repeating MQTT disconnected - esp-mqtt reconnects on its own for ever, and nobody can enable the stop without a rebuild.
findings.suggestedChange: Either enable the policy by default (s_offline_retry_forever = false) or wire a console command or settings toggle to app_mqtt_set_offline_policy(), and make the log text match what the code actually does.

findings.description: Standing owner-level deviations: the factory reset is a 10 s hold of the single front button rather than SET+MODE, and the voice vocabulary has no phrase for the spec example set the office to 21.
findings.evidence: app_logic.cpp:375-376 COMBO_ARM_MS on handles[0]; heating_voice.cpp k_variant_tenth 200, 215, 210; functional report 069 records 17 of 17 phrases without a whole-number-21 variant.
findings.failureScenario: A user holding the front button for 10 s wipes the panel without a confirming combination, and saying the spec example sentence ends in Sorry, not understood.
findings.suggestedChange: Owner decision: restore SET+MODE and add whole-number 21 variants, or record both as accepted deviations.

adc_button_group handles[0]: click push-to-talk, double click dismiss, 1 s hold arms a 10 s factory reset

notes: The settings POST body is now a static buffer (heating_web.cpp:359), removing a 3 KB stack allocation from the 4 KB httpd task; the bounded loop and the form-too-long guard are intact.
heating_on_mqtt_message logs a 48-byte payload copy after matching a configured topic; printf precision bounds each write, and the 96-byte frame is fine on the mqtt task.
A 60 s status_log task (3 KB) now logs broker configured/not-configured, clock and heap.
The new offline policy function exists but has no caller, so the give-up behaviour is unreachable in the shipped image.
The commissioned-reboot crash is unchanged for the fifth build (same PC 0xAFD6A25E) and remains an emulator-side question.

report.summary: The reported settings-page crash is fixed by construction (the 3 KB POST body moved off the httpd stack) and the new logging and console state are wired and bounded, but the newly added broker give-up policy has no caller so it can never fire; the fifth identical emulator Wi-Fi crash and the two owner-level spec deviations remain as documented.
